questions.question: A man carried consecrated meat in his garment and it touched other food. The priests told Haggai the food becomes holy. True or false?
Through the prophet Haggai, the LORD said He struck the people's work with blight, mildew and hail. How did the people respond?

answers.text: They did not turn to Him

questions.question: In the LORD's message through Haggai, what happened on the twenty-fourth day of the ninth month?

answers.text: The foundation of the LORD's temple was laid
The LORD's temple was finished at last
The ark was brought into the temple
